title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
叶辰早有防备，身形一闪，轻松躲过剑气，笑嘻嘻地说道：“五长老，别恼羞成怒嘛，我只是实话实说而已。”六长老趁五长老分心，一掌拍向五长老，掌风呼啸，带着排山倒海之势。五长老急忙一个侧身，才堪堪躲过，然而还是被掌风灵力划破了胸前的衣服，甚至有丝丝嫣红从中渗出。五长老一阵后怕，再也不敢分心了。而叶辰却继续吆喝。“哎！六长老，趁机薅他头发啊！”“打脸，打他的脸啊!”“哎呀！这招要改用‘猴子偷桃’。”“抬腿踹他的脸啊！哎！你五十二码的大脚是干嘛用的！”围观弟子都被惊得目瞪口呆，这是比武，还是泼妇打架？薅头发、打脸、猴子偷桃，这都是什么虎狼之词啊！“小子，你简直放肆至极！”五长老听着叶辰那些不堪入耳的“指点”，只觉一股怒火直冲脑门，额头青筋暴起，双眼仿佛要喷出火来。六长老听着叶辰的“指点”心中微微一动，叶辰每一次“指点”的皆是当时的最佳攻击方式。可这泼妇般的打法他实在难以出手，他虽与五长老不和，但终归还是要些脸面的。只是在不暴露修为的情况下，想要取胜还是比较困难的。“打架嘛，能打赢就行，什么方法不重要。”叶辰无所谓地摊摊手。这时，台上的五长老将怒气全撒在了六长老头上。五长老怒火中烧，手持宝剑气势汹汹地直冲向六长老。六长老反应敏捷，一个侧身便轻松躲过。五长老用力过猛，擦着六长老的身体继续向前冲去。“踹他屁股！”叶辰见状大喊一声。六长老听到叶辰的“指点”，不自觉地抬脚，狠狠踹在五长老的屁股上。五长老被这一脚直接踹下台，摔了个狗吃屎。而那些买了五长老胜的弟子此刻脸色比吃了屎都难看，有人将全部身家都压上了。特别是史克琅，本想让叶辰赔光灵石，此刻，他只感觉是被叶辰给坑了。“叶辰，你这混蛋，竟敢坏我好事，我跟你没完！”五长老狼狈地从地上爬起来，恼羞成怒地指着叶辰吼。

说罢，就要向叶辰出手。“技不如人就别在这里丢人现眼，输了还怪别人，叶辰可是太上长老刚收的弟子，你敢动他？”六长老挡在叶辰前面，警告五长老不要乱来。五长老听闻叶辰是太上长老的弟子，举起的手僵在了半空中，但脸上的愤怒之色丝毫未减。用那要杀人的眼神死死盯着叶辰。最终还是冷哼一声，拂袖而去。叶辰无所谓地耸耸肩，看着五长老离去的背影，嘴角挂起一丝邪笑。他刚才可是在观战弟子的聊天中了解到，这五长老掌管着资源殿，全宗弟子的修炼资源都是从他手里发出的。这个五长老经常利用手里的权力，中饱私囊，克扣弟子们的修炼资源。“这五长老心胸狭隘，保不准会暗中对你使绊子。”看着五长老离开后，六长老对叶辰提醒道。“不怕挨揍就来吧！”叶辰耸耸肩，不以为意地笑了笑。六长老看着叶辰微微一怔，没想到叶辰会这么回答。“不错，难怪能被太上长老收为弟子，以后有什么事，尽管来问剑峰找我。”六长老言罢转身离开。叶辰刚想离开就被史克琅带人围住了。“你们这是？”叶辰不解地问道。“叶辰，你坑我们，你明知道五长老会输，还故意引导我们买五长老胜。”史克琅怒目圆睁，死死地盯着叶辰，恨不得立马对他出手。“屎壳郎，你不要血口喷人，本公子一直都提醒你们要买六长老胜的，是你们自己不听劝。”叶辰双手抱胸，嘴角微微上扬，露出一抹嘲讽的笑容。“你……”史克琅气得浑身发抖，紧紧握紧双拳，青筋暴起，怒目圆睁地死死盯着叶辰，却又不知该如何反驳。其他弟子都羞愧地低下头，是啊，叶辰从开始就提醒他们要买六长老，是他们自己不听劝，要贪图十倍赔偿。史克琅恼羞成怒，大声吼道：“叶辰，我要向你挑战！”“我不接受！”叶辰双手一摊，直截了当地道。史克琅被叶辰直接拒绝，更加愤怒：“哼，不敢接受挑战，你就是个胆小鬼！”

Ye Chen was on guard for a long time. He dodged the sword energy easily and said with a smile: "Fifth Elder, don't get angry because of shame. I'm just telling the truth." The Sixth Elder took advantage of the Fifth Elder's distraction and slapped the Fifth Elder with his palm. The wind roared from his palm with overwhelming force.The fifth elder hurriedly turned sideways and barely managed to escape. However, the clothes on his chest were still scratched by the palm wind spiritual power, and even a trace of bright red seeped out from it.The fifth elder was frightened for a while and no longer dared to be distracted.But Ye Chen continued to shout."Hey! Sixth Elder, take the opportunity to pluck his hair!" "Slap him in the face, slap him in the face!" "Oops! I'm going to use the 'Monkey Stealing Peach' move instead." "Kick him in the face with your leg! Hey! What are your fifty-two feet used for!" The onlookers were stunned. Is this a martial arts competition or a fight between shrews?Pulling out hair, slapping someone in the face, monkey stealing peaches, these are all words of tiger and wolf!"Boy, you are so presumptuous!" The fifth elder heard Ye Chen's unsavory "pointers" and felt a surge of anger rush to his forehead, the veins on his forehead popped out, and his eyes seemed to be spitting out fire.The Sixth Elder's heart moved slightly when he heard Ye Chen's "pointing out". Every time Ye Chen "pointed out" it was the best attack method at that time.But it was really difficult for him to take advantage of this shrew-like attack. Although he was at odds with the Fifth Elder, he still wanted to save some face.It's just that it's difficult to win without exposing your cultivation."It's a fight, as long as you can win, it doesn't matter what method you use." Ye Chen spread his hands indifferently.At this time, the fifth elder on the stage directed all his anger at the sixth elder.The fifth elder was furious, holding a sword and charging towards the sixth elder menacingly.The Sixth Elder reacted quickly and easily dodged by turning sideways.The fifth elder used too much force and continued to rush forward while grazing the sixth elder's body."Kick his ass!" Ye Chen shouted when he saw this.When the sixth elder heard Ye Chen's "guidance", he unconsciously raised his foot and kicked the fifth elder hard on the butt.The fifth elder was kicked off the stage by this kick, and was thrown to pieces.And those disciples who bought the Fifth Elder Sheng looked uglier than eating shit at the moment, and some had invested all their wealth in it.Especially Shi Kelang, who originally wanted Ye Chen to pay for the spiritual stone, but at this moment, he just felt that he had been tricked by Ye Chen."Ye Chen, you bastard, you dare to ruin my good deeds, I'm not done with you!" The fifth elder got up from the ground in a panic, pointed at Ye Chen and shouted angrily.

Having said that, he was about to take action against Ye Chen."If you are not as good as others, don't embarrass yourself here. If you lose, blame others. Ye Chen is the disciple that the Supreme Elder has just accepted. How dare you touch him?" The sixth elder stood in front of Ye Chen and warned the fifth elder not to act recklessly.When the fifth elder heard that Ye Chen was the disciple of the Supreme Elder, his raised hands froze in mid-air, but the anger on his face did not diminish at all.Staring at Ye Chen with those murderous eyes.In the end, he snorted coldly and walked away.Ye Chen shrugged indifferently, looking at the leaving figure of the fifth elder, with a wicked smile on his lips.He had just learned from the chat with the disciples watching that the fifth elder was in charge of the Resource Hall, and all the disciples' cultivation resources came from his hands.This fifth elder often used his power to line his own pockets and deprive his disciples of their cultivation resources."This fifth elder is narrow-minded, and I'm sure he will stumble on you secretly." After watching the fifth elder leave, the sixth elder reminded Ye Chen."Come on if you're not afraid of getting beaten!" Ye Chen shrugged and smiled nonchalantly.The Sixth Elder looked at Ye Chen and was slightly startled. He didn't expect Ye Chen to answer like this."Yes, no wonder he was accepted as a disciple by the Supreme Elder. If anything happens in the future, just come and ask Jianfeng to find me." After saying this, the Sixth Elder turned and left.Just as Ye Chen wanted to leave, he was surrounded by Shi Kelang and others."What are you doing?" Ye Chen asked in confusion."Ye Chen, you tricked us. You knew that the Fifth Elder would lose, and you deliberately led us to buy the Fifth Elder's victory." Shi Kelang's eyes widened with anger, staring at Ye Chen, wishing to attack him immediately."Shit Beetle, don't slander anyone. I have always reminded you to buy the Sixth Elder Sheng. It's because you didn't listen." Ye Chen crossed his arms and raised the corners of his mouth slightly, revealing a sarcastic smile."You..." Shiklang was so angry that he was shaking all over, clenching his fists tightly, veins popping out, staring at Ye Chen with wide eyes, but he didn't know how to refute.The other disciples all lowered their heads in shame, yes, Ye Chen had reminded them from the beginning to buy the Sixth Elder, but they themselves did not listen to the advice and wanted to compensate ten times as much.Shi Kelang became angry and shouted: "Ye Chen, I want to challenge you!" "I don't accept it!" Ye Chen spread his hands and said bluntly.Shi Kelang was directly rejected by Ye Chen and became even more angry: "Huh, you don't dare to accept the challenge, you are a coward!"
